verdict.rationale: LocalAI advertises real-time voice interaction ('Speech in, tool calls in the middle, speech out over WebRTC, fast enough to feel like a conversation') and lists voice/audio as supported modalities, implying on-device speech-to-text capability, but there is no dedicated documentation of a dictation/transcription feature, latency specifics, or model details for STT. Missing for 10: explicit dictation/transcription workflow docs, named STT model/backend, and independent hands-on verification of real-time performance.
